story.label: Our Story
story.title: From frustration to solution
story.paragraph1: Fotomania started when we experienced firsthand the challenges photographers face. Juggling multiple tools for storage, sharing, and delivery was time-consuming and frustrating. We knew there had to be a better way.
story.paragraph2: So we built it. We created a platform that brings everything together in one place: secure storage, beautiful galleries, client proofing, and seamless delivery. All designed to save you time and impress your clients.
story.paragraph3: Today, photographers trust Fotomania with their most important work. We're proud to be part of their creative journey, and we're committed to building tools that help them succeed.

trial.question: How does the free trial work?
trial.answer: All plans include a 14-day free trial with full access to all features. No credit card required to start. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel anytime.

cancel.question: Can I cancel anytime?
cancel.answer: Yes, you can cancel your subscription at any time. You'll continue to have access until the end of your billing period.

storage.question: What happens if I exceed my storage limit?
storage.answer: We'll notify you when you're approaching your limit. You can upgrade to a higher plan or remove some files. We never delete your photos without permission.

upgrade.question: Can I change plans later?
upgrade.answer: Absolutely. You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect on your next billing cycle.
